full_judgment: 2. The petitioners' case is that, one Habibur Rahman auction purchased the case property on 12-4-73 in a certificate case. The sale was confirmed on 4-2-74 and the order for delivery of possession was passed on 25-2-74. Habibur Rahman sold therefrom 0.04 acres of land each to Anwara Begum and another, to Mukhtar Hossain and Akhtar Hossain, to Jamaluddin, petitioner No. 3 and to Kamaluddin Ahmed, petitioner No. 4 variously on 25-5-74 and 26-6-74. On 24-7-84 Anwara Begum, Mukhtar Hossain and Akhtar Hossain transferred 0.08 acres of land to petitioner Nos. 1 and 2, whereby petitioner Nos. 1-4 acquired 0.16 acres of land of the holding in question. The names of the petitioners' vendor and the petitioners have been mutated in the khatian and they have been paying rent and taxes accordingly. The petitioners however are not in possession of the holding in question, but they are the rightful owners of the building the inclusion of which in the "kha" list is totally illegal.
